Review commits 9947cb7ba, 98dfe0291, e10fe93e8: durable Postgres aggregates/idempotency, dev activation, and task record. Focused validation 9 passed. Hosted restart proof is explicitly post-merge.

Changes requested: Postgres candidate review is broken because add_candidate_review requires review_id, but the route never creates one; every review raises KeyError before persistence. Also list_candidate_reviews does not filter by stored subject_id and can return another member's reviews because review payloads omit artifact_id. Add real Postgres parity/integration coverage (not only factory stubs) proving review write/read isolation and restart persistence; make score replacement transactional and update mutations atomic or concurrency-safe before re-review. Focused baseline rerun: 9 passed.
